label: 1.54B_offload_final
note: peak_reserved (6130 MiB) is right at this card's 6141 MiB physical limit -- no real margin. peak_alloc (1154 MiB) matches the design's intent; the gap is NOT activation memory (tested: cutting batch*seq 16x only dropped reserved 2.6%) -- appears to be a largely fixed CUDA/cuBLAS/allocator overhead for this GPU+driver, independent of both offloading correctness and workload size. Not resolved this session; a separate platform-level question, not an offload-mechanism bug.
